northStar: One real workflow reaches a measurable outcome through an accountable operating record.

portfolio.name: Company system
portfolio.job: Turn company priorities, product delivery, evidence, exceptions, and owner decisions into one shared operating record.
portfolio.nextGate: Prove one end-to-end Product workflow with acceptance and usage evidence.

portfolio.name: Website
portfolio.job: Turn an approved business brief into a finite, reviewable website candidate with content, navigation, evidence, and human publish approval.
portfolio.nextGate: Validate one named business brief and accepted local preview before connecting a customer domain or publish authority.

portfolio.name: Ecommerce & Orders
portfolio.job: Convert website or channel demand into controlled order, catalogue, stock, fulfilment, payment-status, and audit records.
portfolio.nextGate: Prove one order-intake-to-close scenario with idempotency, reservation, reconciliation, and operator evidence.

portfolio.name: Commerce
portfolio.job: Convert orders from trusted customer channels into controlled stock, fulfilment, payment, follow-up, and close.
portfolio.nextGate: Connect one approved channel and measure order-handling time, exceptions, and completion.

portfolio.name: Production
portfolio.job: Connect plan, output, quality, materials, equipment, maintenance, and shift exceptions in one production record.
portfolio.nextGate: Validate one line, maintenance, or quality workflow with operator evidence and owner review.

researchGates.gate: Compare Vercel Workflows with the existing Cloud Tasks runtime using one approval-wait use case.
Adopt only after durable execution and centralized approval policy are proven.
Redact customer content and correlate request, workflow, model, tool, and database operations.
Adopt TanStack Table or virtualization only after measured row volume exceeds the native interface.
Add only when simultaneous operators create a measured refresh problem.
Reconsider only if the existing relational system of record and worker runtime cannot meet a documented requirement.

nonGoals: One page or domain per capability
